series.name: LUNA2000-S1 system running indication and ESS indication (Tables 6-3 first power-on, 6-4 system running)
series.notes: S1 uses WHITE LEDs and a capsule-shaped indicator, unlike the S0 green ring (SERIES 6). Four indicators exist: 1 Energy Storage Control Unit, 2 Energy Storage Module, 3 Circular SOC, 4 Capsule-shaped. Table key: short intervals = on 0.2s/off 0.2s, long intervals = on 2s/off 2s. Codes are LED state strings, not numeric alarm IDs. Very relevant to PK because LUNA2000-7/14/21-S1 is the model Huawei lists for Pakistan.

codes.code: Indicator 1 Blinking white at long intervals + Indicator 2 Blinking white at long intervals
aliases: Indicator 1 Blinking white at long intervals + Indicator 2 Blinking white at long intervals

meaning.en: Both module indicators blinking white at long intervals - the ESS is in standby.
meaning.ur: Dono module indicators long intervals par white blink - ESS standby mein hai.

causes.en: PV present but not enough to charge, or the inverter has not called for power.
causes.ur: PV mojood hai lehongi charge karne ke liye kaafi nahi, ya inverter ne power nahi maangi.

solutions.en: Check the app for a paused schedule or a limiter that is holding the ESS in standby.
solutions.ur: App par paused schedule ya limiter check karein jo ESS ko standby mein rok raha hai.

solutions.en: If standby persists in full sun with no schedule, check the AC switch and the battery DC switch.
solutions.ur: Agar poori dhoop mein schedule ke baghair standby bana rahe to AC switch aur battery DC switch check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indicators 1 and 2 blinking white at long intervals (on 2s, off 2s)

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

codes.code: Indicator 1 Blinking red at short intervals
aliases: Indicator 1 Blinking red at short intervals
Battery power control module environment alarm

title.ur: Control unit environment alarm (ESCU ka around ka masla)

meaning.en: Indicator 1 blinking fast red marks an environmental alarm on the Energy Storage Control Unit - typically temperature.
meaning.ur: Indicator 1 fast red blink Energy Storage Control Unit ka environmental alarm batata hai - aam tor par temperature.

causes.ur: Control unit overtemperature, jo alarm 3002 se match karta hai.

causes.en: Enclosure humidity or condensation causing an environmental trip.
causes.ur: Enclosure mein humidity ya condensation se environmental trip hua hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app; expect 3002 for overtemperature.
solutions.ur: App mein numeric alarm padhein; overtemperature ke liye 3002 aayega.

solutions.en: Measure temperature at the control unit and confirm the wall clearance and cabinet airflow.
solutions.ur: Control unit par temperature measure karein aur deewar clearance aur cabinet airflow confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check for water ingress at gland entries, dry the enclosure, then restart in the manual sequence.
solutions.ur: Gland entries par paani ka dakhil check karke enclosure sukha dein, phir manual sequence mein restart karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indicator 1 blinking red at short intervals (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

codes.code: Indicator 2 Blinking red at short intervals
aliases: Indicator 2 Blinking red at short intervals

title.ur: Expansion module environment alarm (pack ka masla)

meaning.en: Indicator 2 blinking fast red marks an environmental alarm on a battery expansion module.
meaning.ur: Indicator 2 fast red blink battery expansion module ka environmental alarm batata hai.

causes.ur: Pack overtemperature, jo alarm 3008 se match karta hai.
Pack low temperature, jo alarm 3009 se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app to separate 3008 (hot) from 3009 (cold).
solutions.ur: App par numeric alarm padhein taake 3008 (garm) aur 3009 (thanda) alag karein.

solutions.en: Measure that pack's surface temperature with a contact thermometer and compare with sibling packs.
solutions.ur: Us pack ka surface temperature contact thermometer se measure karke padosi packs se compare karein.

solutions.en: Only one pack blinking means that pack is the problem - fix its position, do not condemn the whole stack.
solutions.ur: Sirf ek pack blink kar raha hai to masla usi pack ka hai - uski position theek karein, poora stack condemn na karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indicator 2 blinking red at short intervals (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

meaning.en: Indicator 1 solid red: the manual states the battery power control module (ESCU) is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indicator 1 solid red: manual ke mutabiq battery power control module (ESCU) faulty hai.

causes.en: Internal circuit fault in the ESCU, e.g. alarm 3001 Abnormal battery power control module.
causes.ur: ESCU ka internal circuit fault, maslan alarm 3001 Abnormal battery power control module.

causes.en: Fuse blown inside the ESCU, e.g. alarm 3003.
causes.ur: ESCU ke andar fuse udd gaya, maslan alarm 3003.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app - steady red narrows it to 3001/3003 territory, it does not identify the cause.
solutions.ur: App par numeric alarm padhein - steady red use 3001/3003 ki taraf narrows karta hai, wajah nahi batata.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes before opening the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cabinet kholne se pehle teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If 3003, verify the fuse rating against the manual before fitting a new one; a wrong rating is a fire risk.
solutions.ur: Agar 3003 hai to naya fuse lagane se pehle manual ke mutabiq rating verify karein; galat rating aag ka khatra hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

meaning.en: Indicator 2 solid red: the manual states the battery expansion module is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indicator 2 solid red: manual ke mutabiq battery expansion module faulty hai.

causes.en: Internal circuit fault in the pack, e.g. alarm 3006 Abnormal battery expansion module.
causes.ur: Pack ka internal circuit fault, maslan alarm 3006 Abnormal battery expansion module.

causes.en: Pack cable disconnected or pack short circuit, e.g. alarms 3007 or 3010.
causes.ur: Pack ka cable disconnect hai ya pack short hai, maslan alarms 3007 ya 3010.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app and identify the pack position before touching connectors.
solutions.ur: Connectors chhune se pehle app par numeric alarm padhein aur pack position pehchan lein.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches, wait 5 minutes, then reseat and torque the pack power and communication terminals.
solutions.ur: Teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein, phir pack power aur communication terminals dobara lagake torque karein.

solutions.en: If steady red returns with terminals proven sound, plan module replacement - the pack has failed internally.
solutions.ur: Agar terminals theek hone ke baad bhi steady red aaye to module replacement plan karein - pack andar se fail ho chuka hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

codes.code: Capsule-shaped indicator Blinking white at short intervals
aliases: Capsule-shaped indicator Blinking white at short intervals

title.en: Device upgrade and maintenance in progress
title.ur: Device upgrade aur maintenance chal raha hai

meaning.en: The capsule-shaped indicator blinks white at short intervals while a firmware upgrade or local maintenance runs.
meaning.ur: Capsule-shaped indicator short intervals par white blink karta hai jab firmware upgrade ya local maintenance chal raha hota hai.

causes.en: Firmware upgrade or local maintenance session active on the ESS.
causes.ur: ESS par firmware upgrade ya local maintenance session chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Do not cut power during this state; an interrupted upgrade can leave the unit uncommissioned.
solutions.ur: Is state mein power na katte hain; upgrade interrupt hone se unit uncommissioned reh sakta hai.

solutions.en: After the upgrade the manual expects an automatic restart with the indicator settling to steady white.
solutions.ur: Upgrade ke baad manual ko automatic restart aur indicator ke steady white par settle hona expect karta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Capsule-shaped indicator blinking white at short intervals (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

codes.code: Capsule-shaped indicator Blinking white at long intervals
aliases: Capsule-shaped indicator Blinking white at long intervals

title.ur: Operation ke dauran indicator pulsate kar raha hai

meaning.en: The capsule-shaped indicator blinks white at long intervals while the ESS is charging or discharging.
meaning.ur: Capsule-shaped indicator long intervals par white blink karta hai jab ESS charge ya discharge ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; the circular SOC indicator carries the actual SOC reading.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi; actual SOC circular SOC indicator par dikhta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Capsule-shaped indicator blinking white at long intervals (on 2s, off 2s)

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Tables 6-3 and 6-4 indicator definitions

codes.code: First power-on: both indicators blink white slowly 3 times, SOC shows after capsule blinks 3 times, capsule steady on
aliases: First power-on: both indicators blink white slowly 3 times, SOC shows after capsule blinks 3 times, capsule steady on

meaning.en: Expected first power-on behaviour with no AC input: blink white slowly three times on each module indicator, then the capsule-shaped indicator blinks three times, SOC displays, and the capsule indicator goes steady on.
meaning.ur: AC input ke baghair expected first power-on behaviour: har module indicator tees baar slowly white blink, phir capsule-shaped indicator tees baar blink, SOC display hota hai, aur capsule indicator steady on ho jata hai.

causes.en: Correct commissioning behaviour after the black start button is pressed with no AC input.
causes.ur: AC input ke baghair black start button dabaya jane ke baad sahi commissioning behaviour.

solutions.en: Do not treat this pattern as a fault - it is the documented normal first power-on sequence.
solutions.ur: Is pattern ko fault na samajhein - yeh documented normal first power-on sequence hai.

solutions.en: If the sequence stops partway, wait the full window the manual allows before concluding a fault, then check the battery DC switch.
solutions.ur: Agar sequence beech mein ruk jaye to fault ka faisla karne se pehle manual ki di hui poori window wait karein, phir battery DC switch check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indicators 1 and 2 blinking white slowly three times; capsule indicator blinking three times then steady on
